chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, from his father, from al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Hafs al-Jawhari, who said:

Abu al-Hasan 'Ali ibn Muhammad عليه السلام led us in the maghrib prayer. Then he performed the sajdah of shukr after the seventh, so I said to him, "Your forefathers used to prostrate after the third." He said, "None of my forefathers ever prostrated except after the seventh."

key_terms.آبَاؤُكَ: your forefathers, referring to the preceding Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.بَعْدَ السَّابِعَةِ: after the seventh unit, referring to the timing mentioned in the narration
key_terms.سَجْدَةَ الشُّكْرِ: the prostration of gratitude performed after prayer

ai.seo_question: When is the sajdah of shukr performed after maghrib according to Imam 'Ali ibn Muhammad عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Abu al-Hasan 'Ali ibn Muhammad عليه السلام performed the sajdah of shukr after the seventh unit following maghrib, and he clarified that this was the practice of his forefathers as well. The narration is significant for discussions of devotional practice and the timing of sajdah of shukr between the obligatory maghrib prayer and its nawafil.
